title: Relevant coordinate finder
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, a relevant coordinate finder assigns to every coordinate set $P$, fixed sign assignment on $P$, and rational failure parameter strictly between $0$ and $1/2$ a randomized-example learning program returning an optional node decision. It also specifies bounds, depending on the failure parameter, on the number of random examples and local-work units; every supported outcome must use at most those bounds and make zero membership queries. For every sign-valued Boolean function, every coordinate sets $J,P$ with $|J|\le k$, every fixed assignment on $P$, and every inclusion $P\subseteq J$, if the function depends only on coordinates in $J$, then the probability that the program returns no decision or an incorrect decision is at most the failure parameter.
hypotheses_covered: A rational failure parameter in $(0,1/2]$ as encoded by $\mathrm{Set.Ioc}(0,1/2)$
An arbitrary target Boolean function for the cost bound
A supported program outcome for the cost bound
Coordinate sets $J,P$ with $|J|\le k$ for the failure guarantee
